{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the structure and types
print(data.info())

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f"Number of unique patient_id: {data['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Total rows: {len(data)}")
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id rows: {len(data) - data['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check the distribution of arms and severity
print("\nArm distribution:\n", data['arm'].value_counts())
print("\nSeverity distribution:\n", data['severity'].value_counts())

# Check if arm and severity are associated
print("\nCross-tabulation of arm vs severity:\n", pd.crosstab(data['arm'], data['severity']))"}
